name: RocksDB
summary: Structural draft for RocksDB at fixed commit 553b52b4a709. Official documentation identifies a key/value storage engine and log-structured design, but this card does not promote those claims because the cited documentation is not pinned to the analyzed source revision and the fixed source evidence has not yet been inspected semantically.
